name: Giovana Cordeiro
bio: Giovana de Souza Cordeiro (Rio de Janeiro, November 16, 1996) is a Brazilian actress.
place: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

credits.title: Pecadora
credits.overview: Isabel is a very religious young woman whose life is transformed when she starts working with Enrico, a free-spirited and seductive man. As she tries to deny her attraction to her colleague and the awakening of her most forbidden desires, she finds herself confronting everything she always believed.

credits.title: Meu Sangue Ferve por Você
credits.overview: In 1979, Brazilian singer Sidney Magal is at the peak of his career. On a TV show, he meets Magali and, enchanted by the young woman, decides to win her over. But, in order to do that, he will have to overcome the resistance of his manager, Jean Pierre, and the distrust of her family, friends and even Magali herself.

credits.title: Carnaval
credits.overview: Digital influencer Nina finds out about her boyfriend's betrayal and ends the relationship. So, she decides to travel with her friends to Salvador and enjoy the city's Carnival. During this period, they gain more followers and learn the true meaning of friendship.

credits.title: Socorro, Virei uma Garota!
credits.overview: Júlio wanted to be the most popular person in school but ends up getting more than what he wished for.

credits.title: Iara
